title: Junior React Native Developer
description:
Job Description – Junior React Native Developer

**Company:** Zorrro Deliveries Private Limited  
**Position:** Junior React Native Developer  
**Experience:** 0–1 Year (Freshers Can Apply)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Engineering / Mobile Application Development  
**Job Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal  
**Work Mode:** On-site

About Zorrro

Zorrro Deliveries Private Limited is a growing technology and logistics company offering innovative IT solutions, logistics services, and EV rental solutions. We focus on building efficient, technology-driven solutions that help businesses streamline operations and achieve growth.

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior React Native Developer (0–1 year experience) to join our engineering team. The candidate should have a basic understanding of React Native and JavaScript, with an interest in developing mobile applications for Android and iOS. Knowledge of Kotlin and Flutter will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and enhance mobile applications using React Native.
* Create reusable, efficient, and scalable UI components.
* Build responsive and user-friendly interfaces for Android and iOS applications.
* Integrate RESTful APIs and handle API requests, responses, and errors.
* Work with React Hooks, navigation, and state management.
* Identify, debug, and resolve application issues.
* Optimize application performance and ensure a smooth user experience.
* Collaborate with backend developers, UI/UX designers, and other team members.
* Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards.
* Assist in testing, debugging, and deploying mobile applications.

Required Technical Skills

* Basic understanding of React Native and mobile application development.
* Good knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and React fundamentals.
* Understanding of components, props, state, and React Hooks.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive UI development.
* Understanding of REST API integration and JSON data handling.
* Familiarity with Git and GitHub for version control.
* Basic understanding of Android and iOS application development.
* Good logical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills (Added Advantage)

* Basic knowledge of Kotlin and native Android development.
* Familiarity with Flutter and Dart.
* Understanding of Redux Toolkit or Context API.
* Basic knowledge of Firebase, authentication, and push notifications.
* Familiarity with Android Studio and Xcode.
* Understanding of mobile application testing and debugging.
* Basic knowledge of publishing applications on Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

Eligibility Criteria

* B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / B.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, or an equivalent qualification.
* Freshers and candidates with up to 1 year of relevant experience are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with internships, academic projects, or personal mobile application development projects are encouraged to apply.
* A GitHub profile or project portfolio demonstrating practical coding skills will be an added advantage.
* Strong interest in learning and developing mobile applications.

What We Are Looking For

* A proactive individual with a positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong interest in mobile application development and emerging technologies.
* Ability to understand technical requirements and implement solutions.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with the team.

Why Join Zorrro?

* Opportunity to work on real-world technology projects.
* Exposure to modern mobile application development technologies.
* Opportunity to learn and work with experienced team members.
* A collaborative environment that encourages learning and professional growth.

Apply Now!

If you are passionate about mobile application development and want to build your career in React Native, this is an excellent opportunity to start your journey with Zorrro.

**Join Zorrro Deliveries Private Limited and grow with our technology team!**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Web Application Development Intern
description:
**Company: Remote Programmer Pvt Limited**

**Location: Kolkata, India**

**Duration: 3 Months (Paid Internship)**

**Stipend: Competitive**

**About Us:** Remote Programmer Pvt Limited (RP) is a leading software development company with over 25 years of experience delivering high-end web, cloud, and mobile development solutions. We prioritise rapid skill development, innovative processes, and a supportive work environment, ensuring employee and customer satisfaction.

**Job Description:** We seek enthusiastic and talented Web Application Developer Interns to join our dynamic team for a two-month paid internship. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, innovative environment and work with cutting-edge technologies. If you do well during the internship, we may award you with a job offer.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist in developing web applications using React (NextJS) at the front end and Python/PHP at the backend with MySQL/PgSQL/Mongo.
* Collaborate with senior developers to design, develop, and test new features.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to the improvement of our development processes.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues to ensure the smooth functioning of applications.
* Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to bring fresh ideas to the team.

**Requirements:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of web development technologies such as HTML, CSS, SQL, Database Design Concepts, JavaScript, and PHP/Python.
* Familiarity with databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Strong problem-solving skills and a keen eye for detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Good communication skills and a proactive attitude.

**What We Offer:**

* A supportive and friendly work environment.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.
* Exposure to real-world projects and cutting-edge technologies.
* Opportunity to learn and grow within the company.
* Competitive stipend.
* If you do well, we are likely to give you a job offer

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates are invited to submit their resumes and brief cover letters explaining their interest in the internship and relevant skills. Please send your application to [hr@remoteprogrammer.com] with the subject line "Web Application Developer Internship Application—[Your Name]."

**Application Deadline:** There is no deadline, but we will select on a first come, first basis

**Join us at Remote Programmer Pvt Limited and kickstart your career in web development with a rewarding internship experience!**

**Remote Programmer Pvt Limited is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.**

title: Web App Developer ( React + Dot Net)
description:
We are looking for Web App Developers skilled in React and .NET to design, build and maintain web applications, from the user interface to the APIs and database behind it. We have two vacancies at different experience levels. Candidates who can join immediately will be preferred.

***KEY RESPONSIBILITIES***

* Develop responsive web applications using React (JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML, CSS).

* Build and maintain back-end services and REST APIs using .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core / Web API).

* Design and work with databases (SQL Server) including queries, stored procedures and optimisation.

* Convert business requirements and UI designs into working, well-tested features.

* Debug, test and fix issues, and improve application performance and security.

* Take part in code reviews and follow good coding practices using Git.

* Give regular progress updates to the team and management

***REQUIRED SKILLS***

* Strong experience in React, JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3.

* Hands-on experience in .NET / .NET Core, C#, Web API and Entity Framework.

* Good knowledge of SQL Server or similar relational databases.

* Experience in REST API integration, state management (Redux / Context) and Git.

* Good communication skills and the ability to work independently and meet deadlines

***ELIGIBILITY***

* Vacancy 1: minimum 2 years and up to 4 years of experience in React and .NET development.

* Vacancy 2: 4 to 5 years of experience, with ability to own modules and review other developers' code.

* Graduate in Computer Science / IT / BCA / MCA or equivalent (preferred).

* Immediate joiners only; must be able to work from the Kolkata office (Maidan area).

***COMPENSATION & BENEFITS*** • Salary: up to ₹30,000 per month (Vacancy 1) and up to ₹50,000 per month (Vacancy 2), based on interview performance and experience.

* Opportunity to work on live web projects across modern technologies.

* Learning and career growth in a development team.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience with Dot Net + React?
* Can you join immediately?
* What is your current salary?

Work Location: In person

title: Website Development & Digital Solutions Executive
description:
**JOB DETAILS**

**Location:** Kolkata

**Experience: 2+ Y**ears

**Budget** : 3 LPA - 3.6 LPA

**Employment Type:** onsite

**Job Purpose**

The selected candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining company and client websites, creating landing pages, supporting digital marketing execution, implementing basic analytics and assisting with technical configuration and troubleshooting.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

**A. Website Development and Maintenance**

\* Design, develop and maintain professional, mobile-responsive websites.

\* Work with WordPress, themes, plugins, page builders and website hosting platforms.

\* Develop landing pages, enquiry forms and service pages.

\* Update website content, layouts, images and navigation.

\* Configure domains, DNS, SSL, hosting and business email where required.

\* Perform website testing, backups, updates, performance checks and troubleshooting.

\* Support basic e-commerce and digital-download website functionality.

**B. Digital Marketing Technical Execution**

\* Assist in setting up and managing **Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns**, according to demonstrated proficiency.

\* Implement Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.

\* Configure enquiry forms, tracking pixels and campaign landing pages.

\* Monitor website traffic, leads, campaign performance and conversion metrics.

\* Prepare performance reports and recommend practical improvements.

\* Coordinate with the business development team on campaign requirements and lead-generation objectives.

**C. SEO and Website Optimisation**

\* Implement basic technical and on-page SEO.

\* Work with Google Search Console, Google Analytics and keyword research tools.

\* Optimise page titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and images.

\* Identify website errors and opportunities to improve speed, usability and search visibility.

**D. Company and Client Projects**

The employee will work on:

1. CampusGuru Technologies' corporate website and digital infrastructure.

2. Global Painting Conclave's website, including competition pages, artist profiles, artwork galleries and online digital-art sales.

3. Websites, landing pages and digital solutions for CampusGuru clients.

4. Future CRM, analytics, automation and other digital projects, depending on skills and training.

**E. Technical Support and Coordination**

\* Troubleshoot routine website and digital-platform issues.

\* Coordinate with external developers, hosting providers and software vendors when necessary.

\* Maintain documentation, access records and project checklists securely.

\* Assist with client demonstrations, website handovers and basic user training.

\* Ensure that work is completed within agreed timelines and quality standards.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:-**

\* Graduate in Computer Applications, Computer Science, IT, Web Development or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.

\* Approximately 2–4 years of relevant professional experience preferred.

\* Practical experience developing and maintaining WordPress websites.

\* Knowledge of **HTML, CSS and basic JavaScript.**

\* Familiarity with **domains, DNS, hosting, SSL and website troubleshooting.**

\* Working knowledge of website responsiveness, performance optimisation and basic SEO.

\* Familiarity with **Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console**.

\* Basic knowledge of **Google Ads and Meta Ads** campaign execution.

\* Good problem-solving, communication and time-management skills.

\* Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments.

title: Web Development Manager
description:
Job Description: Web Development Manager

**Company Type:** Digital Marketing & Web Solutions Company  
**Job Title:** Web Development Manager  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 3 Years in the Digital Marketing, Web Development, or Web Solutions Industry  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiner Required  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Ruby, Kolkata-700107

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and result-oriented **Web Development Manager** with approximately 3 years of relevant experience in the digital marketing and web solutions industry. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise, excellent leadership qualities, project management skills, and the ability to manage a web development team while delivering high-quality websites and web applications.

The candidate will be responsible for overseeing website development projects, coordinating with designers and digital marketing teams, managing developers, ensuring timely project delivery, and maintaining website quality, performance, and functionality.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead, manage, and mentor the web development team to ensure productivity and quality deliverables.
* Plan, assign, monitor, and manage web development projects from initial requirement gathering to final deployment.
* Oversee the development of business websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, and custom web solutions.
* Ensure websites are responsive, user-friendly, SEO-friendly, secure, and optimized for performance.
* Work closely with the digital marketing, SEO, graphic design, and content teams to meet client requirements.
* Review website designs, coding standards, functionality, and overall project quality.
* Manage project timelines, deadlines, priorities, and team workloads effectively.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and ensure timely resolution of website bugs and errors.
* Coordinate with clients to understand project requirements, provide technical guidance, and communicate progress.
* Ensure proper implementation of website analytics, tracking codes, forms, and third-party integrations where required.
* Manage website hosting, domain configuration, SSL certificates, backups, and deployment processes.
* Stay updated with the latest web development technologies, frameworks, tools, and industry trends.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and maintain high standards of client satisfaction.

Required Technical Skills & Knowledge

* Strong knowledge of **HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive web design**.
* Practical experience with **WordPress, themes, plugins, and website customization**.
* Knowledge of PHP, MySQL, and basic backend development.
* Familiarity with frameworks or libraries such as React, Bootstrap, or other modern web technologies is preferred.
* Experience in e-commerce website development using platforms such as WooCommerce or Shopify.
* Understanding of website speed optimization, Core Web Vitals, mobile responsiveness, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Knowledge of SEO-friendly website structure, on-page technical requirements, URL structure, redirects, and schema basics.
* Experience with hosting platforms, cPanel, domain management, DNS, SSL, and website deployment.
* Familiarity with Git, version control, debugging, website security, and backup management.
* Understanding of APIs, third-party integrations, contact forms, payment gateways, and CRM integrations.
* Basic knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking is an advantage.

Leadership & Managerial Skills

* Strong team leadership and people management abilities.
* Ability to delegate tasks, set priorities, and monitor team performance.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Strong project planning, time management, and multitasking abilities.
* Ability to motivate team members and maintain accountability.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work under deadlines.
* Strong client-handling, coordination, and conflict-resolution skills.
* A proactive attitude with a focus on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Web Development, or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant practical experience and a strong portfolio of completed website projects will be considered.

Eligibility Criteria

* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in web development, preferably within a digital marketing or web solutions agency.
* Prior experience in managing or leading a development team is strongly preferred.
* Must have hands-on technical knowledge along with managerial capabilities.
* Must be comfortable coordinating with designers, SEO specialists, digital marketers, and clients.
* Must be capable of handling multiple website projects and ensuring timely delivery.
* **Immediate joiners or candidates who can join at the earliest will be given preference.**

Salary & Benefits

* **Salary Range:** ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month, depending on experience, technical expertise, and leadership capabilities.
* Opportunity to manage a development team and work on diverse client projects.
* Professional growth in the digital marketing and web solutions industry.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements may share their updated resume along with their portfolio or links to websites they have developed or managed.

**Note:** Candidates with strong technical expertise, proven leadership qualities, relevant agency experience, and immediate availability are encouraged to apply.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Web development: 3 years (Preferred)
* Digital marketing: 1 year (Preferred)
* Team management: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

* East Kolkata Township, West Bengal 700107 (Required)
